plan.summary:
Webhook payloads now use a trimmed event name and a keyed HMAC signature.

- `Event` trims whitespace from the event name.
- `Sign` calls `hmacx.Sum` with the secret instead of hex-encoding the raw body.
- `sign.go` adds the `hmacx` import.
plan.riskRationale: The signing change affects webhook authenticity. The old code did not use the secret. Receivers must now verify a different signature. No tests appear in the diff.
plan.storyArc: The PR first fixes the signature, which is the security-relevant change. It then covers the smaller event-name normalization.

topics.title: Sign webhook bodies with HMAC
topics.narrativeBrief: How does Sign now produce its signature, and why is that different from before? Connect the new hmacx import to the changed return line. Verify what hmacx.Sum computes and that receivers can verify the new output.

topics.title: Trim whitespace from event names
topics.narrativeBrief: What does Event return now? It trims leading and trailing whitespace from the name. Verify the callers and whether the trimmed name is part of the signed payload.
